critical_code_review_comments: CreateGig.jsx uses `const set = ...` on line 83 but references it inside `handleFilesPicked` defined on line 46. Works fine at runtime (set is only invoked after the JSX render commits), but ESLint 'no-use-before-define' would flag it. Consider moving `set` above the handlers for readability.
CreateGig.jsx removeImage(url) filters by URL identity — if the same Cloudinary URL appears twice in gallery (unlikely, since public_id is unique), it will remove both. Fine for MVP.

MyGigsTab.jsx ProfileEditModal only loads existing providerDetails when there is at least one gig (via firstGig.provider_user_id). If a provider deletes their last gig, opening the edit modal will see empty initial values. Minor edge case — provider row still exists server-side; consider a dedicated GET /marketplace/providers/me for the edit modal.

MyGigsTab.jsx: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) uses an empty deps array while `load` closes over `API`/`token`. React lint would warn — acceptable since API/token don't change, but adding an eslint-disable comment or including them in deps would be cleaner.

ProfileEditModal validates none of tagline/bio/whatsapp lengths client-side beyond maxLength on inputs. Backend PATCH should enforce them too — worth confirming in routes/marketplace.py's ProviderPatch model on the next backend iteration.
Modal is closed on outer-div click (line 67). If a user drags text-selection from inside to outside the form, it can fire onClose. Low priority.

uploadFilesFast fallback path in fastUpload.js catches ALL errors on getSignature() and falls back to /api/upload — a signature 500 (misconfig) will silently degrade. Should surface a warn-level log for observability.
